info.description: HTTP API for Kirmya, an AI-assisted professional networking and hiring platform. Every route is mounted under /api/v1. Endpoints marked with a padlock require a Bearer access token from POST /api/v1/auth/login; the rest are open to anonymous callers. Requests are rate limited per client IP, and company, recruiter and organization endpoints apply their own per-company permission checks on top of authentication.

delete.description: Removes somebody from the company team. Requires team:manage on this company. The last owner cannot be removed, so a company can never be left with nobody able to administer it.

Permissions are named individually — there is no wildcard and no implicit inheritance — and the caller cannot grant a permission they do not themselves hold. Use GET /api/v1/companies/permissions for the vocabulary.

400.description: Invalid id, payload or permission name

403.description: Member without team:manage, or privilege escalation refused

get.description: Returns the company's verification status and, if one has been made, its submission. Requires verification:view on this company. Supporting documents are referenced, never inlined, and the references are only readable by the reviewer and the submitting company.

404.description: No such company, or the caller is not a member

post.description: Files the company's registration details and supporting documents for review. Requires verification:submit on this company. 400.description: Invalid id, payload or document reference

404.description: No such company, or the caller is not a member

interviews.description:
The funnel counts behind the rates below. They are reported alongside the
rates so a client never has to multiply a rate back out into a headcount
and present the rounding as a measurement.

isVerified.description:
IsVerified is the only signal the UI should use to render a badge; it is
true only for a completed, unexpired verification.

viewer.description:
Viewer describes what the requesting user may do here. It is empty for
anonymous and unaffiliated callers.

suggestedSkills.description:
SuggestedSkills are the skills the company's own open jobs ask for most
often. They are counted, never guessed.

email.description:
Email is populated only for callers holding team:view; it is the main
piece of employee contact data this module can leak.

extraPermissions.description:
ExtraPermissions are the permissions granted to this member individually,
on top of whatever their role carries. It is populated only for callers
holding permission:edit, because it is what the permissions editor has to
read before it writes: SetMemberPermissions replaces the list outright, so
an editor that could not see the current value would silently erase it.
